text:
Yara Patel: Postmortem follow-up from the latency spike: recurring pattern = long-prefix KV churn + concurrent model init -> brief queuing -> fallback to tiny variant. We need a short, ownerable plan (tests + gates) to stop repeat incidents.

Noah Li: Agreed. Minimal actionable items for next 10 business days: 1) nightly replay regression that replays traces around scale events, 2) a focused promptset for long-prefix eviction, 3) a small load harness to stress continuous batching, 4) a one-off chaos drill on staging.

Sam Ortiz: Prioritization: replay regression first (catches flaky repros), promptset second (semantic assertions), load harness third, chaos drill last (validate fallbacks). I'll take the replay regression. Plan: runner that preserves inter-request timing, nightly for 14 days. Fail criteria: fallback_rate > 1% or p95 degradation > 20%.

Jordan Lee: I'll own the chaos drill + playbook. Proposal: k8s job that simulates 30s of reduced GPU memory during warmup windows and collects KV traces. Draft steps:```bash
kubectl apply -f tools/chaos/gpu_mem_throttle.yaml
sleep 30
kubectl delete -f tools/chaos/gpu_mem_throttle.yaml
```
Run on staging after 3 consecutive green nights. cadence: quarterly.

Maya Singh: I'll take the promptset + eval harness. Promptset will include ~24 pairs (short vs long context), streaming chunk boundaries, and assertions for variant choice and token continuity. Example expectation: `assert fallback_rate < 0.005`. PR target: 5 business days.

Yara Patel: Ownership recap: Sam -> replay runner + CI job (due Tue), Maya -> promptset + eval PR (due Fri), Noah -> load harness + CI (due Wed), Jordan -> chaos playbook + execute (target after 3 green nights). ops-bot create a ticket and schedule a 20m sync.

ops-bot: Created ticket #INC-6102 "kv-eviction: regression suite + promptset + load + chaos" assigned to Yara Patel, due 2025-09-01. Sync scheduled: 2025-08-18 15:00 UTC.

Sam Ortiz: Implementation notes for replay: add `--preserve-timestamps` and `--jitter` flags, allow `--compress` for CI speedups. Local repro: `./tools/replay --trace traces/eviction/2025-08-10.json --preserve-timestamps`. CI job: `ci/jobs/eviction_replay.yml` with matrix {env: staging}. I'll open PR today.

Noah Li: Load harness details: `tests/load/eviction_burst.py` will generate token-heavy bursts at configurable qps and token rates. Initial targets: p50 < 150ms, fallback_rate < 1%. Schedule nightly for 2 weeks then weekly. I'll add dashboards for eviction_rate and fallback_count.

Maya Singh: Promptset snippet in PR will look like:```yaml
- id: evict_long_001
  input: "<long_prefix>..."
  mode: streaming
  expect_contains: "continued"
  assert_variant_not: tiny
```
Includes negative cases and a mock model fixture so CI is stable.

Yara Patel: Add gating suggestion for model swaps: require 7-night rolling green on eviction-related regressions and p95 delta < 10% before swap. We'll draft console copy for the release leads.

Sam Ortiz: Alerts: post to #eng-oncall if nightly replay fails 2 consecutive nights. Also open auto-ticket if 3 consecutive failures. Add an Ops runbook link in the ticket.

Jordan Lee: During the chaos drill enable verbose KV logs and upload traces to s3: `s3://redwood-test/eviction-drill/171900`. Also capture perf traces for model init latency.

Noah Li: CI failing fast: replay job should fail early if fallback spikes > 1% in first 5m to avoid long wasted runs. We'll keep full run for nightly.

Maya Singh: Eval expectation examples: `assert variant_selected in ["base", "large"]`, `assert fallback_rate < 0.01`, `assert token_continuity == True`. Document the rationale in PR.

Yara Patel: Timeline recap: Sam PR + CI job by Tue, Noah load harness + dashboards by Wed, Maya promptset PR by Fri, Jordan chaos playbook draft by next Mon. ops-bot please add owners to INC-6102 and mark in-progress.

ops-bot: Updated #INC-6102 owners and marked status: in-progress. Linked dashboards and PR placeholders.

Sam Ortiz: PR opened (draft): https://github.com/redwood/repro/pull/934 - runner + CI job template. Includes `--compress` support for CI.

Noah Li: I'll add the load job `ci/jobs/eviction_load.yml` and link to graphs.

Maya Singh: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/repro/pull/937 (promptset + mock eval harness). Includes expectations and a short README.

Yara Patel: Thanks team. We'll do a short status update in the scheduled sync and close the ticket when jobs are running nightly and dashboards show baseline. If anyone needs help, ping me or the ops channel. :thumbsup:
